$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a Mediterranean garden studio content seed (Olivetta Garden Studio, Montecito), re-registered in the plaster register with its own page skeletons. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Mediterranean garden design
description: A Montecito garden studio's site kept like a garden journal: warm plaster ground, olive ink and an italic serif. A full-bleed photograph of the villa garden carries the headline; under it the season's stories — spring's lavender walk leading, summer, autumn and winter after it, each jumping to the gardens — then clients' words, the towns, and the invitation to begin a garden.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this business's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Garden walk
types.description: Livia walks the property with you — the light, the soil, the views — and talks through what the garden could become.

types.name: Proposal review
types.description: At the studio on Coast Village Road: the plan, the drawings and the proposal, line by line.

theme.$comment: The plaster register's olive, pinned as the brand so the app surfaces match the marketing pages: the olive of the asks and the datelines, lifted for the night sheet. navigation declares the centered deck (a declared theme variant outranks the shared shell's): the studio's name set over the links like a book's title page. mode light opens on the plaster (the base contractor opens dark, and theme merges shallowly).

landing.$comment: The pin: the plaster register (warm plaster ground, Sorts Mill Goudy with its italic over Karla, the journal treatment and its engraved olive sprig) and the base's title-card home re-ordered for a garden studio — the full-bleed villa garden, the garden journal (showcase stories: the first season leads with its photograph), clients' words, the towns, and the closing invitation. The other pages keep the base's skeletons; resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
